💬 Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS.
For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.
What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.
Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book , which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe , our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.
We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.

Most of our growth so far has happened in England. Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland are three separate health systems, each with its own clinical systems, procurement routes, information governance rules and digital strategy, and none of them have an ICB layer to sell into. This role owns all three.
It is a genuinely blank page. You work out what winning looks like in each nation, then build the repeatable way to do it, selling everything from a single practice subscription to a health board wide agreement.
Owning three health systems, not one region: building pipeline across Scottish and Welsh health boards, clusters, PCNs, GP federations and HSC Trusts in Northern Ireland, and adapting your approach to the structures that actually exist in each.
Selling at every level: running fast, high volume practice level deals alongside long, multi stakeholder board and national negotiations, and knowing which one you are in.
Winning the technical argument: these deals are frequently won or lost on integration. You will hold your own with eHealth teams, IG leads and national bodies on clinical systems, APIs, deployment routes and assurance, without waiting for an engineer to join the call.
Turning pilots into contracts: generating credible local evidence and then converting it into paid, scaled agreements rather than letting it stall as a permanent trial.
Using data to pick your battles: building the territory model from list sizes, usage, adoption and pipeline data, and using it to decide where a national deal is realistic and where practice by practice is the faster path.
Building the playbook: leaving behind documented, repeatable go to market approaches per nation, so this patch scales beyond you.
You should apply if...
You are a proven deal-closer with a track record of carrying your own number and consistently hitting it.
You are comfortable at both ends of the deal size range, equally credible on a quick practice level close and a twelve month, multi stakeholder board negotiation.
You are technically fluent and can pick up how a product integrates with the systems around it, explain it accurately to a technical audience, and stay credible when the questions get detailed.
You are not put off by complexity, whether that is clinical systems, interoperability, deployment routes or information governance. You treat it as part of the sale, not someone else’s problem.
You are a strategic thinker who can build a territory plan from a blank page, defend the choices in it, and change it when the ground shifts.
You are data-led and at home in spreadsheets, CRM and reporting tools, able to turn complex information into clear priorities and a compelling pitch.
You are a self-starter who is energised rather than unnerved by an unmapped patch and no established playbook.
You are mission-driven and motivated by the chance to change how healthcare communication works across three nations at once.
What’s in it for me?
You'll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we're led by our Principles and our mission to solve healthcare productivity.

This role offers a high level of ownership within your book of business, driving the overall account strategy in partnership with SDR’s and sales leadership. This is an opportunity to join a high growth company and sell an award winning product that is experiencing rapid adoption across all industry verticals.

The person in this role will make a major contribution in the company’s growth and future success.

An experienced seller! You have previous experience owning a book of new business, ideally selling into Mid-Market clients. You have a strong track record of success in a SaaS sales environment and can clearly communicate a drive to understand our customers and sales cycle.
You understand Sales is both art and science, and clearly can articulate your version of the “science of sales”.
Hard-working and possess a ‘never give up’ attitude: We have a highly motivated team and a winning culture. We look for people who possess a natural tenacity and desire to succeed.
A Strong Communicator: You have the skills necessary to explain complex financial data and concepts to a non-financial audience. You’re a storyteller with the ability to communicate present and future value to folks at all levels within an organization.
A Hunter: You are constantly working to drive pipeline through your own efforts, in addition to the support of our SDR and Marketing teams.
Intellectually Curious: You know the right questions to ask and how to uncover business challenges at all levels of an organization.
Coachable: You will have the opportunity to advance your career through robust training and development programs at AlphaSense. An openness to feedback and desire for constant improvement is key to success here.
Tenacious: You thrive in environments where you can be creative to get things done!

Take responsibility for the end-end sales processes in your territory, targeting folks in Corporate Strategy, Competitive Intelligence, Business Development, Investor Relations, and M&A.
Research opportunities, prospect, initiate discussions, build relationships, conduct demos, manage product trials, and most importantly: close deals! This is an end-to-end new business sales role and no task is too small or too large.
Partner with our SDR team to create prospecting plans and drive pipeline.
Forecast accurately and develop the necessary pipeline to meet/exceed quota.
Work closely with our Product Specialist team during trials to ensure client engagement and ultimate purchase.
Work closely with Account Management to ensure customer health throughout the contract term, as well as closing down sourced upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
Gather and distribute product feedback from clients and prospects to the sales and product teams to help us continually enhance our product offerings.

s.h: So, what's the role all about?
s.t:
This is a rare opportunity to be the first dedicated Agentic AI sales specialist for NiCE in Japan, a newly created role that puts you at the forefront of one of the most exciting product portfolios in enterprise AI today.
Japan’s enterprise landscape is transforming fast, and NiCE is accelerating its presence here. Your focus will be exclusively on our standalone Agentic AI portfolio — Cognigy Agentic AI, Knowledge Management, Agent Assist, and Proactive AI , solutions designed to deliver immediate value within any existing infrastructure, without ripping and replacing what's already there. That flexibility is your competitive edge in a market where enterprises are ready to adopt AI, but on their own terms.
You won't be doing this alone. You'll be backed by an experienced regional team, world-class pre-sales and solution engineering support, and the full weight of a global organisation that's been winning in this space for years. This is a role with real scope to grow — both in terms of market impact and your own career trajectory within NiCE.
How will you make an impact?
Establish and grow NiCE's Agentic AI presence across Japan's enterprise market, generating new ARR through direct and partner-led sales
Lead full sales cycles end-to-end — from account planning, discovery, and solution design through to commercial negotiation and close
Position NiCE's standalone solutions as powerful complements to customers' existing technology investments, articulating clear ROI and integration simplicity
Build and maintain a strong, qualified pipeline with disciplined forecasting
Engage and influence senior stakeholders — CXOs, CTOs, and VP-level leaders — across BFSI, telecom, retail, and other enterprise verticals
Collaborate with channel and GSI partners to extend reach and accelerate deal velocity
Coordinate with internal pre-sales, product specialists, and solution engineers who are there to support you at every stage
Represent NiCE at key industry events, conferences, and customer forums across Japan
Have you got what it takes?
8+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience with a strong track record in AI, SaaS, or CX technology
Deep familiarity with the Japanese enterprise ecosystem — you understand how large organisations buy, navigate procurement, and manage multi-stakeholder decisions
A hunter mindset: you create pipeline, not just manage it
Ability to position standalone, composable solutions alongside incumbent technologies — this is a strength, not a limitation
Strong commercial acumen — you can build compelling ROI narratives and handle complex deal structures with confidence
Consultative selling skills with the ability to translate AI capabilities into tangible business outcomes
Experience engaging C-suite and VP-level executives across enterprise accounts
Comfortable working across a partner ecosystem including GSIs, regional SIs, and channel partners
Excellent communication and executive presence — in English and Japanese

You will partner with some of the most skilled Customer Engineers in the industry in addition to our Professional Services and Executive teams to help them understand how to execute on your customer’s behalf. Our sales teams have a culture of team success, where you’ll collaborate and be supported by like minded sales professionals.

This role typically reports to a Regional Sales Manager or Area VP of Sales.

We are seeking a proven Territory Account Manager to join our growing Sales organization in the San Francisco Bay Area. As a Territory Account Manager you will act as a trusted advisor and implement sales strategies to exceed sales targets within a targeted list of 30-40 commercial accounts.
Arista appeals to forward-thinking organizations that value quality and innovation. Consequently, technical acumen and a track record of selling data center solutions is highly desirable.

Exceed measurable sales objectives and extend the Arista brand within a named list of both existing commercial accounts and developing net new customers in the greater San Francisco area.

Meet with key influencers, decision-makers, and C-levels to present Arista’s value proposition.
Work with Arista systems engineers to design and position compelling solutions that drive down the total cost of ownership.
Collaborate with technology partners to identify prospects and demonstrate best-in-class solutions
Establish and manage key channel relationships in your territory.
Formulate strategic and tactical account plans based on periodic business reviews with your prospects and customers.
Conduct demand generation activities such as happy hours, lunch-n-learns and technology forums.
Collaborate with Arista peers on marketing plans and best practices.
Keep up-to-date with technology partner solutions, competing solutions and competitor strategies.
You possess a hunter mentality and have a proven track record of technology sales including cultivating relationships with existing customers in addition to penetrating new logo accounts. You are an influencer and possess the ability to act as a trusted advisor to deliver business value to both end users and key business stakeholders.
Our team looks for individuals who embody our values of trust, compassion, collaboration, respectfulness, integrity, and good-natured fun.

Proven track record of direct selling into target accounts within the assigned territory and exceeding sales targets

Excellent people skills and ability to build relationships at all levels
